title: Academic Workload & Context Assessment
purpose: Measures semester course load, perceived curriculum rigor, institutional exam pressure, and personal balance.
description: Gathers academic context to help understand whether student stress is driven by peak semester milestones, credit overloads, or external family expectations.
target_population: Enrolled university students across undergraduate and postgraduate degrees
instructions: Answer the following questions about your current academic term. All questions include options to skip or indicate 'Prefer not to answer' if desired.
source: Calma Educational Prototype - Academic Load Audit.
disclaimer: This questionnaire captures self-reported academic workload perceptions. It does not evaluate academic competence or institutional program accreditation.

scoring.type: Descriptive academic context and feature inputs for exam_pressure and family_expectation
scoring.interpretation: High course loads combined with intense family expectations and low peer support produce the highest risk profiles in our synthetic benchmark dataset.

questions.text: How many total courses / subjects (including theory and lab components) are you registered for this term?
How challenging would you rate the conceptual difficulty of your current courses?
How would you rate the academic expectations placed on you by your family or guardians?

scale_labels.10: Intense expectations to achieve top marks

questions.text: Are you currently experiencing significant financial stress regarding living expenses, tuition, or campus costs?
Do you have sufficient time in a typical week for personal hobbies, physical exercise, or restorative leisure?
options: Yes, ample time for personal pursuits
Just enough to maintain basic hobbies
Very little time (less than 2 hours per week)
Zero personal time; entire schedule consumed by coursework

questions.text: How accessible and helpful are your professors, teaching assistants, or academic mentors when you encounter difficulty?
options: Have not needed to seek faculty help

questions.text: How satisfied are you with your academic performance so far this semester?

scale_labels.10: Fully satisfied and proud of results
